BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ergonomics rules; and adding a new section tochapter 49.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Rules dealing with musculoskeletal disorders, filed on May 26,2000, by the director, and codified as WAC 2966205101 through 2966205176, are repealed. The director shall not adopt any new or amendedrules dealing with musculoskeletal disorders that are substantially thesame as these rules until and unless required by congress or thefederal occupational safety and health administration.
